contract: Each author_jsx is independent AE ExtendScript run with an already created 320x180 2s 24fps comp and mediaRoot absolute path. linearKeys(property,times,values) sets LINEAR key interpolation. One fresh .aep and separate 30fps full-duration Adobe MP4 per case. Do not use exported FX or converter output as an oracle. Record actual source SHA/bytes/composition ID and independent long-term reference Asset/SHA/bytes after production; absent pins fail closed. Never overwrite an existing oracle.

cases.author_jsx: var t=comp.layers.addText('EDITABLE'); t.name='Panel Text'; var p=t.property('ADBE Text Properties').property('ADBE Text Document'); var d=p.value; d.font='ArialMT'; d.fontSize=42; d.fillColor=[0.2,0.4,0.8]; d.applyFill=true; d.applyStroke=false; d.justification=ParagraphJustification.CENTER_JUSTIFY; p.setValue(d); t.transform.position.setValue([160,90]);

var t=comp.layers.addText('MOTION'); t.name='Animated Text'; var textDoc=t.property('ADBE Text Properties').property('ADBE Text Document'); var td=textDoc.value; td.font='ArialMT'; td.fontSize=42; td.applyFill=true; td.fillColor=[1,1,1]; td.applyStroke=false; textDoc.setValue(td); t.transform.position.setValue([160,90]); var g=t.property('ADBE Text Properties').property('ADBE Text Animators').addProperty('ADBE Text Animator'); g.name='Position Selector'; g.property('ADBE Text Animator Properties').addProperty('ADBE Text Position 3D').setValue([0,40,0]); var s=g.property('ADBE Text Selectors').addProperty('ADBE Text Selector'); linearKeys(s.property('ADBE Text Percent Start'),[0,1],[0,100]);

var t=comp.layers.addText('PATH'); t.name='Path Text'; var textDoc=t.property('ADBE Text Properties').property('ADBE Text Document'); var td=textDoc.value; td.font='ArialMT'; td.fontSize=42; td.applyFill=true; td.fillColor=[1,1,1]; td.applyStroke=false; textDoc.setValue(td); t.transform.position.setValue([0,0]); var m=t.property('ADBE Mask Parade').addProperty('ADBE Mask Atom'); m.name='Text Guide'; var sh=new Shape(); sh.vertices=[[30,90],[290,90]]; sh.inTangents=[[0,0],[0,0]]; sh.outTangents=[[0,0],[0,0]]; sh.closed=false; m.property('ADBE Mask Shape').setValue(sh); var options=t.property('ADBE Text Properties').property('ADBE Text Path Options'); options.property('ADBE Text Path').setValue(1); options.property('ADBE Text First Margin').setValue(18);

var a=comp.layers.addSolid([0.2,0.5,0.1],'Backdrop',320,180,1,2); var b=comp.layers.addSolid([0.8,0.2,0.2],'Foreground',110,70,1,2); b.name='Foreground'; b.transform.anchorPoint.setValue([0,0]); b.transform.position.setValue([60,50]); b.transform.opacity.setValue(65); b.blendingMode=BlendingMode.MULTIPLY; linearKeys(b.transform.position,[0,1],[[60,50],[130,85]]);

var base=comp.layers.addSolid([0.8,0.3,0.2],'Masked',240,120,1,2); base.transform.position.setValue([160,90]); var m=base.property('ADBE Mask Parade').addProperty('ADBE Mask Atom'); m.name='Inset Mask'; var sh=new Shape(); sh.vertices=[[0,0],[160,0],[160,100],[0,100]]; sh.inTangents=[[0,0],[0,0],[0,0],[0,0]]; sh.outTangents=[[0,0],[0,0],[0,0],[0,0]]; sh.closed=true; m.property('ADBE Mask Shape').setValue(sh); m.property('ADBE Mask Feather').setValue([6,6]); m.property('ADBE Mask Opacity').setValue(75); var matte=comp.layers.addSolid([1,1,1],'Matte',100,100,1,2); matte.transform.position.setValue([160,90]); base.setTrackMatte(matte, TrackMatteType.ALPHA);

comp.motionBlur=true; comp.shutterAngle=210; comp.shutterPhase=-40; var s=comp.layers.addSolid([0.2,0.7,0.9],'Spatial Solid',90,70,1,2); s.threeDLayer=true; s.motionBlur=true; s.transform.orientation.setValue([15,25,5]); s.transform.position.setValue([160,90,35]); linearKeys(s.transform.property('ADBE Rotate X'),[0,1],[0,25]);

var s=comp.layers.addShape(); s.name='Gradient and Dashed Stroke'; s.transform.position.setValue([0,0]); var v=s.property('ADBE Root Vectors Group'); var r=v.addProperty('ADBE Vector Shape - Rect'); r.property('ADBE Vector Rect Size').setValue([130,65]); r.property('ADBE Vector Rect Position').setValue([160,90]); var g=v.addProperty('ADBE Vector Graphic - G-Fill'); g.property('ADBE Vector Grad Type').setValue(1); g.property('ADBE Vector Grad Start Pt').setValue([95,90]); g.property('ADBE Vector Grad End Pt').setValue([225,90]); var st=v.addProperty('ADBE Vector Graphic - Stroke'); st.property('ADBE Vector Stroke Color').setValue([1,0.2,0.1,1]); st.property('ADBE Vector Stroke Width').setValue(6); st.property('ADBE Vector Stroke Line Cap').setValue(2); st.property('ADBE Vector Stroke Dashes').addProperty('ADBE Vector Stroke Dash 1').setValue(12); st.property('ADBE Vector Stroke Dashes').addProperty('ADBE Vector Stroke Gap 1').setValue(7); /* Closed Rectangle exposes dash spacing, not cap pixels; cap remains structural-only. */

var s=comp.layers.addShape(); s.name='Boolean and Modifiers'; s.transform.position.setValue([0,0]); var v=s.property('ADBE Root Vectors Group'); var a=v.addProperty('ADBE Vector Shape - Rect'); a.property('ADBE Vector Rect Size').setValue([125,80]); a.property('ADBE Vector Rect Position').setValue([145,90]); var b=v.addProperty('ADBE Vector Shape - Ellipse'); b.property('ADBE Vector Ellipse Size').setValue([90,90]); b.property('ADBE Vector Ellipse Position').setValue([190,90]); v.addProperty('ADBE Vector Filter - Trim').property('ADBE Vector Trim End').setValue(75); v.addProperty('ADBE Vector Filter - Merge').property('ADBE Vector Merge Type').setValue(2); v.addProperty('ADBE Vector Graphic - Fill').property('ADBE Vector Fill Color').setValue([0.9,0.3,0.2,1]);

var child=app.project.items.addComp('Panel Effects Child',320,180,1,2,24); var s=child.layers.addSolid([0.2,0.4,0.7],'Child Solid',120,90,1,2); s.transform.position.setValue([160,90]); var e=s.property('ADBE Effect Parade').addProperty('ADBE Gaussian Blur 2'); e.property('ADBE Gaussian Blur 2-0001').setValue(8); var instance=comp.layers.add(child); instance.name='Nested Effects';
